title: i opened the Fellvault mobile beta here’s what goes into a build
author: Knuckleclot
selftext:
i’m making fellvault, a portrait idle rpg where your hero farms cleared stages while you’re away. when a keeper stops you, you can change your build and try the fight again.

in this clip i turn shards into an artifact sword, earn its third enchant star, evolve a sigil, and fuse an attack + crit glyph. i finish by picking riftblade and unlocking my first mastery node. it’s a late-game showcase save so you can see the whole loop.

[iOS · TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/SvqA7er9)

Android · [Google Play opt-in for invited testers](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.fellvault.prototype) or [join the waitlist](https://fellvault-web.vercel.app/#beta).

if you play, tell me which keeper stopped you first and what upgrade you tried next.

ai helped with code and some in-game text, and some in-game art is ai-generated. the clip is recorded gameplay.
